title: Artifact publication manifest
description: The value of the `spec-kit-jira-artifacts` entity property on a specification-tier ticket. Records what the bridge has already published, one entry per artifact path, carrying the last published content hash. It is a CACHE, never the truth: when the ticket's real attachment list contradicts an entry, the artifact is republished (contracts/artifact-publication.md C4.3). It holds the CURRENT state only — the publication history lives in the ticket's comment stream — so its size is bounded by the number of artifacts, not by the number of runs.

schema.description: Shape version. A change to the SET of recorded fields bumps it. A reader that does not recognise the value treats the manifest as absent and republishes every artifact — never as an error, and never as a reason to write.

artifacts.description: Keyed by the artifact's path relative to the feature directory, `/`-separated on every host. Never an absolute path: it would carry the operator's home directory into a Jira record and break byte equivalence between ports and machines.

hash.description: `git hash-object --no-filters` of the bytes last successfully published for this path. The comparison that decides published / revised / unchanged.

attachment_id.description: The Jira attachment id returned for that publication. Lets a later run check the ticket's real attachment list and republish when the manifest is ahead of reality.

run.description: The lifecycle event that published it. Diagnostic only — no decision reads this.
